correctness.rationale: Degree-two flip propagation makes any flip on an odd ring impossible. Nonconstant two-cycles force exactly the connector path to flip; its phase-zero bits alternate. Fixed ring interiors are precisely opposite-end words with all runs of length at least two. Two independent words and one endpoint phase give a bijection with 2W_aW_b temporal states, hence W_aW_b primitive orbits, independent of distance. Exact run-composition and generating-function identities prove the formula for every odd a,b>=3 and d>=1. The 56-case exhaustive C++ test and separate 8-case constructive Python test with 99 algebraic coefficient checks pass. No infinite claim depends on those finite tests.

value.rationale: The theorem resolves a natural two-odd-ring weak-coupling question for all graph sizes and arbitrary path length. It proves two previously isolated non-oscillating odd cycles support a unique connector-localized mechanism, with exactly distance-invariant exponential-in-ring-size orbit counts, parity-coded endpoint phases, a sharp size threshold and exact decay in uniform initial-state prevalence with distance. The local Fibonacci enumerator is known, but the all-distance gluing rigidity and factorization are not merely restated local data.
